系统的提示音不断响起。

许默手指如飞，精准地在一堆破铜烂铁中挑出真正的极品。

一口表面布满粗犷纹路的雕花石锅，特性栏赫然挂着大厨二字。

五卷透着淡淡草药味的绷带，主打强效止血。

一件质地坚硬、散发着沉木幽香的木质胸甲。

以及一张野人石板烤肉配方。

许默顺手将胸甲套在身上，感受着木质纹理贴合肌肤带来的厚重安全感，嘴角却不自觉地绷紧。

优势积累得太快了，甚至有一种近乎虚幻的顺畅感。

林子深处的黑暗蠕动、交织、膨胀。

那蛰伏在黑暗深处、仅凭暮色便能令人理智狂掉的未知怪物，真的会满足于只在黑夜逡巡吗？

一旦这脆弱的日夜规则被打破，现在积累的这点底牌，恐怕连塞牙缝都不够。

压下心头寒意，许默快步走到农田前。

意念闪动，浆果灌木根系凭空出现。

他屏住呼吸，双手稳稳托住那虬结的巨根，小心翼翼地将其嵌入松软的黑土中央，随后将周围的泥壤一寸寸夯实。

翻开储物面板，一块白色的鸟粪肥落入掌心。

许默单膝跪地，目光如尺，精准地在距离根部五十厘米的地方挖出一个小坑，将肥料深埋进去。

刚想去取水，脚底传来的黏腻感让他动作一顿。

沾满泥浆的鞋帮甚至透着一丝凉意。

前天那场大雨下得太透，地表下的水分早就饱和了，这时候再浇水，那娇贵的根系绝对会直接烂在地里。

他拍了拍手上的泥土，拎着剩下的肥料走出门。

围绕着庇护所外墙，许默目光扫视，挑了两个隐蔽且不碍事的死角，挥动石斧挖坑，各自埋下一块鸟粪肥。

狡兔三窟。

肥料这东西绝不能全指望别人，谁知道那个叫朱瑶的女人哪天晚上运气不好，直接被这该死的世界规则给优化掉。

“吃饭了，尝尝我的石板烤肉。”

方芸清脆的嗓音从屋里飘了出来，混杂着一股直往人天灵盖里钻的浓烈肉香。

许默推门而入。

壁炉里跳动着橘红色的火苗，那口新交易来的雕花石锅正架在上面，发出诱人的滋滋声。

几块切得厚薄均匀的狼肉在锅底翻滚，边缘已经被烫得微微卷起，表面泛着一层金黄的油脂。方芸正捏着一小撮粗盐末，均匀地撒在肉块上。

许默眼中闪过一抹讶异，指尖不自觉地摩挲了一下大腿侧面。

图纸才交出去不到半小时。

The system's beeps kept ringing.

Xu Mo's fingers were flying, and he accurately picked out the best ones among the piles of junk.

A carved stone pot with rough textures on its surface, with the word "chef" prominently displayed on the attribute column.

Five rolls of bandages with a faint herbal scent, focusing on powerful hemostasis.

A wooden breastplate with hard texture and exuding the fragrance of agarwood.

and a Savage Slate Roast recipe.

Xu Mo put the breastplate on his body smoothly, feeling the deep sense of security brought by the wooden texture against his skin, but the corners of his mouth tightened unconsciously.

The advantages accumulated so quickly that there was even an almost illusory sense of smoothness.

The darkness deep in the forest squirmed, intertwined, and expanded.

Is that unknown monster that lurks in the depths of darkness and can drive people crazy with just the twilight light, really content with just patrolling in the dark night?

Once this fragile day and night rule is broken, the few trump cards accumulated now may not even be enough to fill the gap between the teeth.

Xu Mo suppressed the chill in his heart and walked quickly to the farmland.

With a flash of thought, the roots of the berry bush appeared out of thin air.

He held his breath, held the giant root firmly with both hands, carefully inserted it into the center of the soft black soil, and then compacted the surrounding mud inch by inch.

Opening the storage panel, a piece of white guano fell into the palm of my hand.

Xu Mo knelt on one knee, with his eyes like a ruler, he accurately dug a small hole fifty centimeters away from the roots and buried the fertilizer deeply.

Just as he was about to get water, the sticky feeling coming from the soles of his feet made him hesitate.

There was even a hint of coolness in the muddy uppers.

It rained so heavily the day before yesterday that the water under the surface has long been saturated. If you water again at this time, the delicate roots will definitely rot directly in the ground.

He patted the dirt on his hands and walked out with the remaining fertilizer.

Xu Mo glanced around the outer wall of the shelter, picked two blind spots that were hidden and out of the way, dug holes with a stone ax, and buried a piece of guano in each.

The cunning rabbit has three caves.

You can't rely entirely on others for fertilizer. Who knows that the woman named Zhu Yao will have bad luck one night and be directly optimized by the rules of this damn world.

"It's time to eat, try my slate barbecue."

Fang Yun's clear voice floated out from the room, mixed with a strong meaty aroma that penetrated directly into the human and heaven spirit cap.

Xu Mo pushed open the door and entered.

Orange flames danced in the fireplace, and the newly purchased carved stone pot was placed on it, making an alluring sizzling sound.

Several pieces of wolf meat cut evenly in thickness were tumbling on the bottom of the pot. The edges had been slightly rolled up by the heat, and there was a layer of golden grease on the surface.Fang Yun was holding a pinch of coarse salt and sprinkled it evenly on the meat.

A flash of surprise flashed in Xu Mo's eyes, and his fingertips unconsciously rubbed the side of his thigh.

The drawings were handed over less than half an hour ago.
